notes: POWO accepts D. linearis; D. linearis var. decumbens is instead placed under accepted D. decumbens, so local infraspecific assumptions should not be made from old names.

target_zone_range_leads.guardrail: Research-only. Deep Review must verify accepted taxonomy and exact target-zone native counties; no county inference.
leads: POWO lists south-central Oklahoma to Mexico and Texas as native.
Master Plant Pool marks Hays Local and Personal List.

UT Williamson County documents D. linearis locally; Purola's introduction list shows that the preserve's own D. linearis material was introduced, so that cultivated record must not be used as native Hays evidence.

morphology_candidate.look_here_first: Start with the tiny growth form and leaves: a low rhizomatous plant with very narrow opposite linear-oblanceolate leaves and solitary axillary lavender flowers.
diagnostic_traits: rhizomatous perennial, often only 10–20 cm tall
purple bilabiate corolla with darker throat markings
capsule mostly enclosed by persistent calyx

confusers.separator: Dyschoriste is lower with narrow almost linear leaves and solitary axillary flowers; Dicliptera is taller with broader ovate leaves and paired condensed cymes with conspicuous bracts.
